files.content:
"use client";

import { Button, Menu } from '@mantine/core';

function Demo() {
  return (
    <Menu width={200} position="bottom-start">
      <Menu.Target>
        <Button>Toggle Menu</Button>
      </Menu.Target>

      <Menu.Dropdown>
        <Menu.Item>Dashboard</Menu.Item>

        <Menu.Sub>
          <Menu.Sub.Target>
            <Menu.Sub.Item>Products</Menu.Sub.Item>
          </Menu.Sub.Target>

          <Menu.Sub.Dropdown>
            <Menu.Item>All products</Menu.Item>
            <Menu.Item>Categories</Menu.Item>
            <Menu.Item>Tags</Menu.Item>
            <Menu.Item>Attributes</Menu.Item>
            <Menu.Item>Shipping classes</Menu.Item>
          </Menu.Sub.Dropdown>
        </Menu.Sub>

        <Menu.Item>Customers</Menu.Item>
        <Menu.Item>Reports</Menu.Item>

        <Menu.Sub>
          <Menu.Sub.Target>
            <Menu.Sub.Item>Orders</Menu.Sub.Item>
          </Menu.Sub.Target>

          <Menu.Sub.Dropdown>
            <Menu.Item>Open</Menu.Item>
            <Menu.Item>Completed</Menu.Item>
            <Menu.Item>Cancelled</Menu.Item>
          </Menu.Sub.Dropdown>
        </Menu.Sub>

        <Menu.Sub>
          <Menu.Sub.Target>
            <Menu.Sub.Item>Settings</Menu.Sub.Item>
          </Menu.Sub.Target>

          <Menu.Sub.Dropdown>
            <Menu.Item>Profile</Menu.Item>
            <Menu.Item>Security</Menu.Item>
            <Menu.Item>Notifications</Menu.Item>
          </Menu.Sub.Dropdown>
        </Menu.Sub>
      </Menu.Dropdown>
    </Menu>
  );
}

function SafeAreaPolygonDemo() {
  return (
    <Menu width={200} position="bottom-start">
      <Menu.Target>
        <Button>Toggle Menu</Button>
      </Menu.Target>

      <Menu.Dropdown>
        <Menu.Item>Dashboard</Menu.Item>

        <Menu.Sub offset={16} safeAreaPolygon={{ buffer: 16, requireIntent: false }}>
          <Menu.Sub.Target>
            <Menu.Sub.Item>Products</Menu.Sub.Item>
          </Menu.Sub.Target>

          <Menu.Sub.Dropdown>
            <Menu.Item>All products</Menu.Item>
            <Menu.Item>Categories</Menu.Item>
            <Menu.Item>Tags</Menu.Item>
            <Menu.Item>Attributes</Menu.Item>
            <Menu.Item>Shipping classes</Menu.Item>
          </Menu.Sub.Dropdown>
        </Menu.Sub>

        <Menu.Item>Customers</Menu.Item>
        <Menu.Item>Reports</Menu.Item>
      </Menu.Dropdown>
    </Menu>
  );
}
const RendynExampleComponent = Demo;
export function RendynExample() { return <RendynExampleComponent  />; }
const RendynExample2Component = SafeAreaPolygonDemo;
export function RendynExample2() { return <RendynExample2Component  />; }

documentation:
# Mantine Menu

Open a menu of actions from a trigger control.

## Installation

- Complete MIT usage examples extracted from the upstream demo code template; documentation configurator machinery is excluded.
- Mount MantineProvider once at your client application root and import @mantine/core/styles.css. The returned preview wrapper is a standalone example; reuse an existing provider when integrating.

- Copy every returned file and preserve the MIT licence notice.
- Render the returned preview.tsx example, or integrate the example into your existing provider.
